items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: Ohio Tax Credit AuthorityがTekni-Plex, Inc.(Van Wert市)に対し、雇用創出税額控除(JCTC、7年間1.311%)を承認。新規常勤雇用100人・年間給与$4,816,000の創出を約束する内容。
items.infer: Tekni-Plexは包装・プラスチック製品メーカーであり、新規雇用創出の規模から工場での生産能力拡張投資が伴う可能性(推論)。加工機・成形機・搬送・検査装置などの需要につながる可能性がある。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.311% for 7 years on 2023-05-08 for a project in the City of Van Wert, Van Wert County. Commitment: create 100 full-time equivalent employees generating $4,816,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.

Indiana IEDC SEF contract (SEF 職業訓練助成) executed 2016-10-20, status contractEnded. Contract amount $50,000; expected investment $4,200,000; actual investment to date $0; jobs at contract end 16; base jobs 208; paid to date $50,000; compliant True.
